entities.name: Uyo
entities.description: Greatest of the soratami seers, a mute telepath known as the silent.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: Man Uyo tortured mentally, who froze her.

entities.name: Disciples of Uyo
entities.description: Uyo's pupils who guided soratami strategy.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: Intervened to help Toshi regain his senses.

entities.name: yuki-onna
entities.description: Bearer of the power Toshi stole.

events.summary: Uyo takes on punishing Toshi Umezawa, torturing him with mental images from her palace.
events.quote: Uyo took the task upon herself

events.summary: The Myojin of Night's Reach helps Toshi regain his senses and traps Uyo in her own vision.
events.quote: the intervention of the Myojin of Night's Reach helped Toshi to regain his senses

events.summary: Toshi uses the yuki-onna's power to freeze Uyo, who shatters.
events.quote: Her body then toppled and shattered into frozen shards.

relations.quote: Her best disciple and right-hand was Chiyo
Toshi to use the power of the yuki-onna to freeze her alive
